subject: Consolidated route snapshot + action rollup for Console roadmap
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.example>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated route snapshot + action rollup for Console roadmap

Team —

Quick ask before Friday's product/eng sync: we need a single-page synthesis of per-route cost vs p95 latency that we can present to PM/eng leadership and to Acme (they want visibility into why their bill jumped last month). Goal is a prioritized action rollup (3 buckets: quick UX fixes, infra fixes, roadmap candidate) with owners and estimated effort.

What I need from each of you by EOD Thursday: 
- Marissa: a csv with top 50 routes by token spend + p50/p95 latency (sample window: Feb 1–Mar 1).
- Irene: any security or data residency notes that would affect a public tile or tenant-facing report (SOC2/privacy flags).
- Dylan: short ops notes on which routes have active caching/batching profiles and any known SLO exceptions in the last 30 days.
- Jasmine: UX/PM sketch of what a single "route snapshot" card would show (1 paragraph).

I'll stitch together into a 1-pager for the sync and drop the doc into the Observability Roadmap folder. If Acme needs a redacted view, let's include a column for tenant-visibility level.

Thanks — Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Director, Product — Console
Redwood Inference

Attachment: route-snapshot-matrix.csv (CSV, 92KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.example>
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated route snapshot + action rollup for Console roadmap

Sergio — attaching the requested CSV and a short extraction with my quick read. Highlights: 

- Top cost routes (by token spend): /api/chat.open, /api/embed.multiple, /api/generate.longform — together 58% of token cost.
- Latency tail: chat.open shows p95 spikes correlated with long-context requests (>2k tokens) and when caching is disabled.
- Quick wins (2–3 sprint): expose per-route sample rate and a "recommended cache prefix" in the Console; add an inspector link that opens a sampled trace.
- Infra fixes (month): enable adaptive batching knob for chat.open and tune kernel selection for sequence lengths > 1k.

I added inline columns in route-snapshot-matrix.csv: owner, sample_rate, cache_enabled, recent_slo_hits. I also attached a one-page PDF (proposal-action-rollup.pdf) with suggested owners and rough JIRA epics.

Notes/questions: 
- Do we want the card to show cost delta vs prior month or a 90-day trend? Either works but delta is easier to parse quickly.
- If this is tenant-visible, we need a landlord-mode to redact other tenants and show relative rank.

Happy to jump on a 20-minute sync with you and Dylan tomorrow to walk through.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Staff Product Manager, Observability
Redwood Inference

Attachments: route-snapshot-matrix.csv, proposal-action-rollup.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 14 Mar 2029 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated route snapshot + action rollup for Console roadmap

Sergio/Marissa — couple of quick compliance points to consider if this becomes tenant-facing:

- Redaction: any exported "per-tenant" view must remove tenant IDs unless the tenant has explicitly consented or the view is restricted to internal users. For Acme share, provide an anonymized view and mark which samples are aggregated across tenants.
- Audit trail: we need to capture who viewed the tenant map and when; add an access log hook that ties to existing audit logging (SOC2 requirement).
- Data retention: any downloaded CSV should have an accompanying retention notice and expire link if we host it.

I can draft the short compliance blurb for the one-pager and recommend a minimal set of guardrails (redaction, access gating, advisory language).

Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.example>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.example>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 15 Mar 2029 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidated route snapshot + action rollup for Console roadmap

Quick ops notes after I sampled the routes Marissa sent: 

- cache_enabled flag is inconsistent across environments; for a reliable sample we should normalize flags in the sampling pipeline before we show p95.
- Several SLO exceptions (Feb 21–Mar 3) for /api/generate.longform were due to a bad quantization kernel that we patched 2029-03-02 — include "last mitigation date" column in the snapshot so we don't prioritize already-fixed items.
- For adaptive batching: it's feature-flagged; estimate ~2 wks dev + 1 wk rollout for full in-prod enablement (depends on QA matrix).

Proposal for the 1-pager: include 3 columns for each route — (1) cost impact this window, (2) suggested immediate action + owner, (3) blockers/notes (security/infra). I'll merge Marissa's CSV with an ops column and drop the combined file into the Drive link you listed.

Loop me into the sync and I'll run through the ops blockers live.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Senior SRE
Redwood Inference
